mapper.select: select attachment_id, biz_type, biz_id, file_url, file_name, file_size, upload_user_id, create_by, create_time from biz_attachment where attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_attachment (biz_type, biz_id, file_url, file_name, file_size, upload_user_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadUserId}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_attachment where biz_type = #{param1} and biz_id = #{param2}
mapper.delete: delete from biz_attachment where biz_type = #{param1} and biz_id = #{param2}
